review.tagline: One proxy for LLM, MCP and A2A traffic with auth and RBAC
review.summary: Agentgateway is a Linux Foundation proxy for agent traffic: an LLM gateway (OpenAI-compatible API, budgets, failover), an MCP gateway federating tools over stdio, HTTP, SSE and Streamable HTTP, and an A2A gateway. It adds JWT, API key and OAuth auth, CEL RBAC, rate limits, guardrails and OpenTelemetry, and runs standalone from YAML or as a Kubernetes controller with Gateway API.
review.audience: platform teams securing MCP, A2A and LLM traffic
strengths: One proxy for LLM, MCP and A2A traffic with an OpenAI-compatible API
MCP federation over stdio, HTTP, SSE and Streamable HTTP plus OpenAPI tools
JWT, API key and OAuth auth with CEL-based RBAC and rate limits
Standalone YAML mode or Kubernetes controller with Gateway API
weaknesses: README has no install command, ports or resource needs; quickstart is external
Inference routing assumes Kubernetes Inference Gateway extensions
Marked in active development; roadmap is the issue tracker
Guardrail backends beyond regex are cloud services (OpenAI, Bedrock, Model Armor)
needs: Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock and other providers; self-hosted models via inference routing
